answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-lock: each agent must stake tokens locked for 30 epochs, forming a trellis of bonded identities visible to peers. An attacker spawning N fakes must lock N stakes; collusion costs scale linearly while rewards per identity sink toward the lagoon's floor. If reputation ever hits its nadir, the stake is slashed, so fake agents burn capital with no payout. Honest agents amortize one stake across many tasks, making the attack strictly more expensive than participation. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
